idea: Family & friends #1 – DADDY'S BIRTHDAY (KITCHEN, Ava in PARTY outfit in her pink high chair, Daddy Tom in HOME outfit): a big blue-frosted cupcake with ONE lit striped candle pops up right beside Baby Ava's face ('Wow! Look! A birthday cupcake!'); chorus 'Happy birthday, Daddy! I love you!'; she shows her toddler-crayon red heart card ('I made a card! A big red heart!'), Daddy Tom arrives and she gives it to him ('Here you go, Daddy! Happy birthday!'); copy-me 'Blow with me! Whoo, whoo, whoo!' – they blow out the candle together; she asks the viewer 'Who is the cupcake for? Hmm?' (pause) – 'For Daddy! For my Daddy! Yay!'; lesson 'I love my family!'. Loop: the hook framing with the cupcake, bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A Birthday Cupcake! 🧁 Happy Birthday, Daddy! | Family Song with Baby Ava | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A birthday cupcake pops up right next to Baby Ava in the kitchen! 🧁 It's Daddy Tom's birthday – sing along as Ava gives Daddy her red heart card, blows out the candle with him and says "I love you, Daddy!"

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A birthday cupcake!"
❤️ "I made a card! A big red heart!"
🎁 "Here you go, Daddy! Happy birthday!"
🎂 "Blow with me! Whoo, whoo, whoo!" – blow out the candle with Ava and Daddy!
🤔 "Who is the cupcake for?" – can you answer?
👋 "I love my family!" Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: family words • Daddy • happy birthday • I love you • showing love to your family

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A sweet sing-along family song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Ava and Daddy Tom celebrating his birthday in the kitchen: making a card, blowing out a candle together and saying I love you.
